clips.title: The story
paras: In warlocks’ hands, the Reconstructed Tome gathers the scattered teachings of the cabal. Its pages hold the rites for summoning and binding a felhunter from the Twisting Nether.

Warlocks of the Alliance and Horde search for the torn leaves of the Tome of the Cabal. They piece the grimoire back together and consult occult scholars, who are eager to glimpse its rare teachings before the finished book is surrendered.
